Rich in Inuit culture and history, Auyuittuq is “the land that never melts” in Inuktitut. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/WET4/index/randonnee-hiking-640x360.jpg?modified=20221115190835)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/activ/randonnee-hiking) ### [Explore the Akshayuk Pass](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/activ/randonnee-hiking) Hike, ski or snowshoe through this 100 kilometre-long natural corridor. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/WET4/index/cercle-circle-640x360.jpg?modified=20231102175303)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/activ/decouverte-tours/cercle-circle) ### [Cross the Arctic Circle](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/activ/decouverte-tours/cercle-circle) Experience spring in Auyuittuq on a guided day trip from Pangnirtung to the Arctic Circle. [![Trois randonneurs avec des sacs à dos traversant la toundra et entourés de montagnes. ](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/WET4/index/pic-ulu-peak-640x360.jpg?modified=20230628205005)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/activ/decouverte-tours/pic-ulu-peak) ### [Discover Ulu Peak!](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/activ/decouverte-tours/pic-ulu-peak) Looking for a summer day trip? Join this guided hike from Pangnirtung to Ulu Peak. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/WET4/activ/guides-640x360.jpg?modified=20231102180826)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/visit/guides) ### [Local guides and outfitters](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/visit/guides) Arrange transportation to and from the park or book your trip with a guided group. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/WET4/index/skidoo-640x360.jpg?modified=20231102175247)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/info/permis-licenses-permits) ### [Permits and licenses](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/info/permis-licenses-permits) Get information on business licenses, filming and commercial photography, research, firearms, and more. [![An inuksuk with an iceberg in the background.](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/WET4/index/inuksuk2-640x360.jpg?modified=20231102175437)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/info) ### [Cooperative management](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/info) Learn how Inuit and Parks Canada work together to manage Auyuittuq. ## Most requested - [How to get here](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/visit/directions) - [Important bulletins](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/securite-safety/bulletins) - [Brochures and publications](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/visit/cartes-maps) - [Polar bear safety](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/securite-safety/ours-bears) - [Permits and licenses](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/info/permis-licenses-permits) ## Visiting Auyuittuq National Park ### [Activities and experiences](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/activ) Things to do, hiking, skiing, climbing and mountaineering, guided trips, and backcountry camping. ### [Plan your visit](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/visit) How to get to here, where to stay, guides and outfitters, maps, brochures, and visitor information. ### [Camping and overnight accommodations](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/activ/camping) Types of accommodations, backcountry camping, where to stay in Pangnirtung and Qikiqtarjuaq. ### [Tours and programs](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/activ/decouverte-tours) Guided spring and summer day trips departing from Pangnirtung and Qikiqtarjuaq. ### [Safety and guidelines](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/securite-safety) Important bulletins, weather and wildlife safety, terrain hazards, search and rescue, visitor guidelines. ### [Fees](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/visit/tarifs-fees) Daily visitor fees, overnight camping, annual backcountry passes, and fishing permits. ## About Auyuittuq National Park ### [Nature and science](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/nature) Conservation, research and monitoring, the environment, and protecting species. ### [Culture and history](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/culture) Auyuittuq's rich human history dates back over 3,000 years. ### [Stewardship and management](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/info) Cooperative management, plans and policies, implementation updates, contact information. | | [How to get here](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/visit/directions) ### Contact Auyuittuq National Park **General inquiries:** 867-473-2500 (Pangnirtung) 867-927-8834 (Qikiqtarjuaq) 1-888-773-8888 (toll free) [nunavut.info@pc.gc.ca](mailto:nunavut.info@pc.gc.ca) **For emergencies within the park:** 1-780-852-3100 ### Hours of operation The park is open year-round. Park offices: [Complete schedule](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/visit/heures-hours) ### \#AuyuittuqNP - [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/ParksCanadaNunavut/) - [Twitter](https://x.com/ParksCanNunavut) ## More places to discover with Parks Canada [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nu/qausuittuq-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220409)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/qausuittuq) ### [Qausuittuq National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/qausuittuq) A home for the endangered Peary caribou and a traditional Inuit hunting and fishing area on Bathurst Island in Nunavut’s High Arctic. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nu/quttinirpaaq-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220410)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/quttinirpaaq) ### [Quttinirpaaq National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/quttinirpaaq) Inuktitut for “land at the top of the world”, Quttinirpaaq is Canada’s northernmost national park, a vast arctic wilderness on Ellesmere Island. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nu/sirmilik-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220410)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/sirmilik) ### [Sirmilik National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/sirmilik) Narwhals, belugas, polar bears and thousands of seabirds thrive in the Arctic landscape of Bylot Island and Baffin Island’s Borden Peninsula. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nu/ukkusiksalik-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220410)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/ukkusiksalik) ### [Ukkusiksalik National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/ukkusiksalik) An area rich in arctic wildlife and Inuit history where hundreds of archaeological sites dot the landscape surrounding Wager Bay. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nu/epaves-wrecks-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220409)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nu/epaveswrecks) ### [Wrecks of HMS Erebus and HMS Terror National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nu/epaveswrecks) Learn about Sir John Franklin’s legendary 1845 expedition and the role of Inuit knowledge in the discoveries of the shipwrecks. # Polar bear safety

## Auyuittuq National Park

### [Avoiding an encounter](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/securite-safety/ours-bears/eviter-avoid)

Essential safety tips and how to plan ahead to reduce the risk of encountering polar bears in Auyuittuq.

### [Handling an encounter](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/securite-safety/ours-bears/rencontre-encounter)

What to do if your group encounters a polar bear in Auyuittuq, how to prepare, and how to get help in an emergency.

### [Choosing a safe campsite](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/securite-safety/ours-bears/camping)

Where to set up your tent, places to avoid, and best practices to prevent polar bears from approaching your camp in Auyuittuq.

### [Deterrents and warning systems](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/securite-safety/ours-bears/dispositifs-deterrents)

Bear spray, noisemakers, electric fences and other polar bear deterrents to keep your group safe in Auyuittuq.

Nanuq, the great white bear, is found in many of Canada’s northern national parks and in some national historic sites. Whenever bears and people occupy the same area, conflict can arise. Polar bears and people have coexisted for thousands of years but contact between the two must be minimised to continue this legacy. Successful polar bear conservation requires your co-operation.

Polar bears may be encountered at any time of the year and in any area of Auyuittuq, including glaciers. The more people in your party, the less likely you will encounter a bear. Groups of up to 12 people are permitted. In Auyuittuq National Park, polar bears are most active in and along the coast of Davis Strait. Be particularly cautious in March/April when females with cubs are emerging from their dens and August to November when the sea ice is gone and bears are forced ashore. When in North Pangnirtung Fiord we recommend travelling at least 3-4 hours inland before camping, if possible.

Each encounter with a polar bear is unique. Good judgement, common sense, and familiarity with polar bear behaviour are required in all situations. This information provides guidelines for avoiding and dealing with polar bear encounters. For your safety and the safety of the bears, please read this section carefully and seriously consider the risks involved with travel in polar bear country.

If you choose to travel in polar bear country, take the necessary precautions. The more people in your group, the greater the chances of deterring a bear. Read the following pamphlet carefully:

- [Safety in Polar Bear Country Pamphlet](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/pn-np/nu/auyuittuq/archive/pdf/shared/PolarBearSafety_English.pdf) (PDF, 2.02 MB)
